target.title: fix(i18n): add missing Model Providers translations for all 20 locale files
target.body: ## What Problem This Solves Fixes an issue where non-English users would see untranslated English text throughout the Model Providers settings page (`/settings/model-providers`) when the UI language is set to any of 20 supported languages. Each locale file had 17–18 keys — including navigation labels, status indicators, and informational strings — that remained in English rather than the user's selected language, creating an inconsistent mixed-language experience. ## Why This Change Was Made All untranslated `modelProviders` keys across 20 locale files were translated to their respective target languages, following the conventions already established by the surrounding translated sub-sections (`credentials`, `apiKey`, `probe`, `logout`, `add`, `defaults`, `readOnly`, `notes`). The deeply nested keys had been translated previously; this change fills in the top-level and status/info keys that were missed during initial localization. ## User Impact Users of all 20 supported languages will see a fully localized Model Providers settings page, consistent with the rest of the settings UI. This covers the page title, subtitle, empty state messaging, connection status labels, credential expiry notifications, model counts, live usage stats, and session cost display. ## Evidence | Language | File | Keys Translated | |---|---|---| | Arabic (العربية) | ar.ts | 18 | | German (Deutsch) | de.ts | 18 | | Spanish (Español) | es.ts | 18 | | Persian (فارسی) | fa.ts | 18 | | French (Français) | fr.ts | 18 | | Hindi (हिन्दी) | hi.ts | 17* | | Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia) | id.ts | 18 | | Italian (Italiano) | it.ts | 18 | | Japanese (日本語) | ja-JP.ts | 18 | | Korean (한국어) | ko.ts | 18 | | Dutch (Nederlands) | nl.ts | 18 | | Polish (Polski) | pl.ts | 18 | | Portuguese / Brazil (Português) | pt-BR.ts | 18 | | Russian (Русский) | ru.ts | 17* | | Thai (ไทย) | th.ts | 18 | | Turkish (Türkçe) | tr.ts | 18 | | Ukrainian (Українська) | uk.ts | 18 | | Vietnamese (Tiếng Việt) | vi.ts | 18 | | Simplified Chinese (简体中文) | zh-CN.ts | 18 | | Traditional Chinese (繁體中文) | zh-TW.ts | 18 | > *hi.ts and ru.ts: 17 keys each — the `refreshing` key was already translated prior to this change. All existing translations in the nested sub-sections (`credentials`, `apiKey`, `probe`, `logout`, `add`, `defaults`, `readOnly`, `notes`) are unchanged — only the 18 previously-missing keys were filled in per language. Verification: a post-translation string-matching check confirms zero remaining English text for the 18 target keys across all 20 locale files. ### Local metadata baseline verification Ran the canonical sync command — all 20 locale files are clean with zero fallback keys. No `.i18n/` metadata drift was produced. ``` $ OPENCLAW_CONTROL_UI_I18N_AUTH_OPTIONAL=1 node --import tsx scripts/control-ui-i18n.ts sync --write control-ui-i18n: command=sync locales=20 zh-CN: clean (fallbacks=0) zh-TW: clean (fallbacks=0) pt-BR: clean (fallbacks=0) de: clean (fallbacks=0) es: clean (fallbacks=0) ja-JP: clean (fallbacks=0) ko: clean (fallbacks=0) fr: clean (fallbacks=0) hi: clean (fallbacks=0) ar: clean (fallbacks=0) it: clean (fallbacks=0) tr: clean (fallbacks=0) uk: clean (fallbacks=0) id: clean (fallbacks=0) pl: clean (fallbacks=0) th: clean (fallbacks=0) vi: clean (fallbacks=0) nl: clean (fallbacks=0) fa: clean (fallbacks=0) ru: clean (fallbacks=0) control-ui-i18n: catalog: fallback_keys=0 fallback_pairs=0 ``` Verification via `check` passes without errors: ``` $ node --import tsx scripts/control-ui-i18n.ts check control-ui-i18n: catalog: fallback_keys=0 fallback_pairs=0 ... (20/20 all clean) # exit code: 0 ``` No `.i18n/` metadata files were modified — the manual translations are structurally complete and require no AI fallback entries. ### Before/after sample (zh-CN.ts) | Key | Before | After | |---|---|---| | `tabs.modelProviders` | Model Providers | 模型提供商 | | `subtitles.modelProviders` | Configured providers with plan, quota, and cost. | 已配置的提供商，包含套餐、配额和费用信息。 | | `modelProviders.title` | Configured providers | 已配置的提供商 | | `modelProviders.subtitle` | Model providers with auth, plan, quota, and cost data. | 包含身份验证、套餐、配额和费用数据的模型提供商。 | | `modelProviders.refreshing` | Refreshing… | 正在刷新… | | `modelProviders.disconnected` | Connect to the gateway to see configured model providers. | 连接到 Gateway 以查看已配置的模型提供商。 | | `modelProviders.emptyTitle` | No model providers configured | 未配置模型提供商 | | `modelProviders.emptySubtitle` | Sign in to a provider or add an API key, then refresh. | 登录提供商或添加 API 密钥，然后刷新。 | | `modelProviders.status.expiring` | Expiring | 即将过期 | | `modelProviders.status.missing` | Not signed in | 未登录 | | `modelProviders.status.apiKey` | API key | API 密钥 | | `modelProviders.expiresIn` | Credential expires in {time} | 凭据将于 {time} 过期 | | `modelProviders.models` | {count} models | {count} 个模型 | | `modelProviders.modelOne` | 1 model | 1 个模型 | | `modelProviders.modelsAvailable` | {available} of {count} models available | {count} 个模型中 {available} 个可用 | | `modelProviders.noStats` | No live usage data reported by this provider. | 此提供商未报告实时使用数据。 | | `modelProviders.localCost` | Session spend · {days}d | 会话消耗 · {days}天 | | `modelProviders.localCostDetail` | {tokens} tokens · {sessions} sessions | {tokens} 令牌 · {sessions} 个会话 | page before: page after:
